newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Oct state borrowing need seen 5 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Oct state borrowing need seen 5 bln SKR.

text.p: Sweden's state borrowing requirement for October was forecast at five billion crowns on Tuesday by the National Debt Office.
The forecast for September was revised to five billion crowns from six billion crowns and the actual borrowing level for August was confirmed at one billion crowns.
The office left unchanged its state borrowing requirement forecast for calendar 1996 at 40 to 50 billion crowns.
The National Debt Office said it planned to issue 13 billion crowns in treasury bills and six billion crowns in bonds in October.
It said it would issue 12 billion crowns in treasury bills and six billion crowns in bonds in September.
